collector_note: OUTSIDE-TRUTH pack. Built primary-source-first from SEC EDGAR (CIK 0001823608) filings and the company's own Q2 2026 earnings release, with prices cross-checked across three independent quote sources. WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted before this pack started; all retrieval was direct HTTP against named endpoints. India-shaped fields (bse_code, promoter/FII/DII, face value in INR, standalone-vs-consolidated) are structurally inapplicable to a US bank holding company and are recorded as world_gaps, NOT as zeros.

former_names.value: No true rename. The SEC EDGAR formerNames array contains exactly ONE entry and it is the SAME string as the current name: {name: 'Amalgamated Financial Corp.', from: '2020-09-08', to: '2026-09-17'}. This is an EDGAR metadata refresh, not a name change. The genuine predecessor relationship is an ISSUER SUCCESSION, not a rename: Amalgamated Financial Corp. became the Nasdaq-listed issuer as successor to Amalgamated Bank on 2021-03-01 via a holding-company reorganization (Form 8-K12B).

roce.note: ROCE (return on capital employed) is not a disclosed or meaningful metric for a bank holding company - there is no 'capital employed' line in a bank balance sheet in the industrial sense. The filed analogues are ROA 1.49% (Q2 2026), core ROA 1.42%, and ROATCE 16.51%.

debt_to_equity.computed_check: Total debt $79.60M / total stockholders' equity $834.993M = 0.0953. Equity figure is SEC-primary; total debt is from the aggregator.
debt_to_equity.note: The aggregator does not publish a D/E for this name (banks are normally excluded). Value is COMPUTED here, not quoted. For a deposit-funded bank, D/E excludes the $8.5B deposit base and is therefore close to meaningless as a leverage read - use the filed regulatory ratios instead: Tier 1 leverage 9.20%, CET1 14.20%, TCE/TA 8.74%.

primary_source_conflict.note: RECORDED, NOT SMOOTHED. Summing the company's own quarterly 'net revenue' across the last four quarters lands materially ABOVE the aggregator's $333.86M TTM revenue (Q2 2026 alone is $98.4M). 'Revenue' for a bank is definitionally unstable - net interest income, net revenue (NII + non-interest income), or total interest income are all defensible and all different. Do not mix bases across a diff. Q4 2025 was not separately tagged as a quarterly XBRL fact (annual 10-K period only), so an exact primary-source TTM recomputation was not completed.

A pipeline that zero-fills these fabricates data.

consolidated_vs_standalone.value: US GAAP CONSOLIDATED only. Amalgamated Financial Corp. reports on a consolidated basis (holding company plus its subsidiary Amalgamated Bank). The Indian standalone-vs-consolidated duality does not exist here - there is no separate 'standalone' statement set to confuse a resolver. The live axis for this name instead is GAAP vs 'core' (non-GAAP), which the company publishes side by side with equal prominence.

traps.detail: 'AMAL' resolves to TWO unrelated listed companies that BOTH sit in the app's masters: (a) NASDAQ:AMAL = Amalgamated Financial Corp., a Delaware public benefit corporation and bank holding company, USD, market cap ~$1.42B; (b) BSE 506597 = Amal Ltd, an Indian bulk-chemicals maker (sulphuric acid, oleum), ISIN INE841D01013, INR, an Atul Ltd subsidiary. Two continents, two currencies, two industries, one string. Resolution MUST key on exchange, never on the bare symbol. A currency-blind merge produces a bank holding company with a price of 722 or a chemicals maker with a P/E of 12.64.

The battery manifest records 'Q EPS $0.80 vs $0.95 estimate (-15.79% surprise)'. Verified against the source: $0.80 is the Q1 2026 CORE (non-GAAP) DILUTED EPS - i.e. the WRONG QUARTER and the WRONG BASIS. Two errors compounded. The latest reported quarter is Q2 2026: GAAP diluted $1.15, core diluted $1.10. Q1 2026 GAAP diluted was $0.84, Q1 2026 core diluted was $0.80. Any 'EPS missed by 15.79%' narrative attached to the current quarter is wrong twice over - Q2 2026 was described by the company as record net income, record core net income and record profitability, with guidance raised.

The company publishes GAAP and 'core' (non-GAAP) EPS with equal prominence in the same bullet list. For Q2 2026 they differ by $0.05 ($1.15 vs $1.10); for Q2 2025 core was ABOVE GAAP ($0.88 vs $0.84), so the sign of the gap flips across quarters. Analyst consensus for US banks usually tracks core/operating EPS, so a surprise computed against GAAP EPS can invert. Pick a basis and hold it.

The manifest records an UNRECONCILED conflict: quoted 2026-09-04 price $49.17 exceeding a quoted all-time high $47.89 (2026-07-01). RECONCILED HERE, and it is not a data error in either figure - both are genuine, both are STALE. $49.17 is the true regular-session CLOSE on 2026-09-04 (Yahoo daily bar; that session's range was 48.79-49.45). $47.89 is the true INTRADAY HIGH on 2026-07-01, and it was in fact the highest high of the preceding twelve months AS OF that date. The 'conflict' is purely an artifact of two snapshots taken at different times and then compared as if simultaneous. The stock subsequently traded to $51.59 intraday on 2026-08-13 and closed 2026-09-18 at $47.40.

$47.89 was labelled an ALL-TIME high; it was at best a running 52-week/period high as of 2026-07-01, and it has since been exceeded ($51.59 intraday on 2026-08-13). Separately, only twelve months of price history were retrieved in this session, so no all-time high is asserted here at all - $51.59 is recorded strictly as the 52-week high. Treat any aggregator 'all-time high' on this name as unverified.

SEC EDGAR's formerNames array for CIK 0001823608 contains exactly one entry whose name string is IDENTICAL to the current name - {'Amalgamated Financial Corp.', from 2020-09-08, to 2026-09-17}. A pipeline that reads formerNames and emits 'renamed' will report a rename dated two days before this collection, with an unchanged name. There has been no rename. The real predecessor event is an ISSUER SUCCESSION (Amalgamated Bank -> Amalgamated Financial Corp., effective 2021-03-01, Form 8-K12B), which is a different relation entirely and is not captured by formerNames.

'Revenue' has no single meaning for a bank. The company's own release reports Q2 2026 NET REVENUE of $98.4M and NET INTEREST INCOME of $86.1M; the aggregator reports TTM 'revenue' of $333.86M, which is LESS than four times the single-quarter net revenue. Total interest income (gross) would be higher again. Any field-by-field diff that compares an in-app 'revenue' against an outside 'revenue' without pinning the definition will produce a false mismatch or, worse, a false match.

SEC EDGAR history for CIK 0001823608 begins 2020-09-08 (Form S-4EF); the first 10-K is for FY2020. Before the 2021-03-01 reorganization the listed issuer was Amalgamated Bank, which filed its periodic reports with the FDIC under Exchange Act Section 12(i), NOT with the SEC. Long-horizon fundamental history pulled from EDGAR alone will appear truncated at ~2020 even though the ticker has traded since 2018 and the institution dates to 1923.

At 2026-06-30: 31,207,172 shares ISSUED but only 29,900,147 OUTSTANDING, the 1,307,025 difference being treasury stock carried at $37.942M. Market cap computed off the issued count overstates by ~4.4% ($1.479B vs $1.417B). An active $40M buyback authorization means this gap widens over time.

promoter_pct, fii_pct, dii_pct, pledged_pct_of_promoter have NO US counterpart. They are structurally absent, not merely undisclosed. Zero-filling them fabricates a company with no promoter and no pledging, which will silently pass a null-check and then feed a screener. The honest US analogue is institutional ownership (64.03%) plus SC 13D/G beneficial-ownership filings.

The company describes the same event two ways: the 8-K says an ADDITIONAL $31.4M was authorized on top of $8.6M remaining (= $40M available); the earnings release says 'a new $40 million share repurchase program was approved'. A news-extraction pipeline will produce a $40M new authorization where the filing supports $31.4M.
A 20:1 FORWARD split occurred 2018-07-30 (pre-IPO recapitalization). Price series reaching before that date must be split-adjusted; an unadjusted series shows a ~20x discontinuity.

'Amalgamated' is a crowded name family. Amalgamated Bank (NY, the subsidiary here) is DISTINCT from Amalgamated Bank of Chicago, an unrelated institution with a similar name and similar union-founded history. Separately the holding company (Amalgamated Financial Corp.) and the bank (Amalgamated Bank) are different legal entities with different filing histories and different regulators - the bank, not the holdco, is the B Corp and Global Alliance for Banking on Values member.
Listed on the Nasdaq GLOBAL MARKET (NASDAQ-GM), not the Global Select Market. Sources that report a bare 'NASDAQ' lose the tier; sources that assume Global Select are wrong.

Filed Q2 2026 return on average equity is 17.04% (single quarter, annualized); the TTM ROE is 14.28%; core return on average TANGIBLE common equity is 16.51%. Three different correct numbers for 'ROE' on the same company in the same quarter. A diff that flags 14.28 vs 17.04 as an error is flagging a basis difference.

The ten most recent EDGAR filings as of 2026-09-19 are ALL Forms 4 and 144 (insider sales) dated 2026-09-11 through 2026-09-17. The most recent company announcement is nearly two months older (2026-07-23). Sorting EDGAR by filing date without filtering form type yields 'latest announcement: Form 4' - noise, not news.
